newsitem.title: USA: Toro to acquire irrigation firm for $130 million.
newsitem.headline: Toro to acquire irrigation firm for $130 million.

text.p: Toro Co., the maker of home and commercial landscape products, said Thursday it has agreed to buy the James Hardie Irrigation Group from Australia-based James Hardie Industries Ltd. for $130 million.
Toro is the world's largest maker of irrigation sprinkler heads and Laguna Niguel, Calif.-based James Hardie is a major manufacturer of irrigation products to the residential and commercial markets.
The company said the combination will position Toro as a stronger, more cost effective competitor. Toro stock was off 12.5 cents at $33.75 in afternoon trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
